description: This circular diagram visually represents four core properties of a reasoning benchmark, each occupying a quadrant of the circle. The top-left quadrant, colored yellow, is labeled "Complexity" and features a ladder icon; the top-right quadrant, colored light blue, is labeled "Instance" and features a shield icon; the bottom-left quadrant, colored red, is labeled "Scalable Oversight" and features a clipboard icon; and the bottom-right quadrant, colored green, is labeled "Coverage" and features a globe with gears icon. Surrounding the circle are four rectangular labels, each corresponding to a quadrant: "Uncrushable" (top-left, yellow border), "Unhackable" (top-right, light blue border), "Auto-verifiable" (bottom-left, red border), and "General" (bottom-right, green border). The chart lacks percentage labels, a legend, or any visual emphasis on specific segments, and the quadrants appear to be arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-left.
